answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The grove lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the pulse is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
